text: Hello, so sorry to be messaging this late, I know your probably really busy with proper emergancies and I feel silly even typing this. I'm a foster carer and I've had a little boy placed with me, he's 2 months old, only been with us a short while so I'm still learning his ways and I don't have his mum to ask what's normal for him. I just took his temprature with the ear thermometer and it says 38.5. I did it twice to make sure and it was the same both times. I've fostered older kids before but never one this tiny and I honestly don't know if a temp like that in a baby this young is something to wait on till morning or not. My social worker isnt answering because its the middle of the night obviously. Sorry again for bothering you, I just didn't want to get it wrong with him. What should I be doing?
